node.title: Regex on a variable with special characters
node.author: jaydee
node.doctext:
I have 2 variables one is simple like below. $x = "SERVER-NAME"; and I am trying to see if $y starts with $x, but $y sometimes contains regex special characters like ()[], also ** which can give me errors.

How can I safely check if $x at the start of $y?

$y =~ /^$x/; is the current regex I am using.
